<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that break a halide (the Cl on the sulfonyl chloride) and form a sulfonamide, which matches the transformation from an aryl sulfonyl chloride and an amine to the aryl sulfonamide product.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(N(S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1))cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
